QuestInfo.name: The Great Moustachiolanche
QuestInfo.0: Spiegelmann looks sad. Ask him what's wrong.
QuestInfo.1: Spiegelmann's pretty sure his order got lost.\r\nUse the #bEastern Portal#k to travel to the #eSecluded Park#n to find his lost Delivery Box.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: You returned Spiegelmann's moustache box to him, along with a lot of other people's packages. That was probably illegal.

0.0: I can't go outside like this. It's unseemly! My face looks like a raw pile of bread dough without the 'stache! You have to help me.

yes.0: Those delivery drivers must have lost my package! Go find it! I bet they took it to the Secluded Park. They always do that. You could also check the Dust Box... just... bring every Delivery Box you find! I don't care who it belongs to.

no.0: What sort of hairless wasteland are you trying to bring about?!

item.0: Find it! You have to find it! Why aren't you finding it!?
